jsonld.description: Catalogue of body treatments at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm: wood therapy, pressotherapy, post-operative lymphatic drainage and muscle pain recovery. Expert manual technique, validated protocols and personalised diagnosis.

faq.q: How many post-operative drainage sessions do I need?
faq.a: It depends on the surgery and the recovery stage, but the standard protocol is 8-12 sessions spread across the first 4-6 weeks post-op. During the diagnosis we review your medical report, surgery date and design the exact plan.

faq.q: Does wood therapy work against cellulite?
faq.a: Yes, especially when combined with consistency (nutrition, hydration, movement). Wood therapy visibly improves the appearance of cellulite by stimulating circulation and drainage. It isn't magic, it's sustained manual work — and the results show.

faq.q: Do pressotherapy and wood therapy complement each other?
faq.a: Very much so. Wood therapy works the fascia and subcutaneous fat manually; pressotherapy drains lymphatic fluid with sequential pressure. Combined within the same session, results multiply — it's one of the protocols we recommend most for heavy legs and cellulite.

faq.q: After a liposuction, when can I start the drainage?
faq.a: Usually between 5 and 10 days after surgery, following your surgeon's instructions. The key point: specific post-operative drainage (not a generic massage) as soon as the doctor authorises it. The sooner you start, the better the recovery.

Lymphatic drainage is very gentle — it doesn't hurt. Wood therapy and muscle recovery have a medium-high intensity depending on your tolerance, but always within the therapeutic threshold. If at any moment it becomes too much, we adjust. We never treat anyone enduring pain.

hero.h1_html: Your body doesn't need another machine. It needs hands that know where to insist.
hero.lead_html: Fluid retention, heavy legs, post-surgical recovery, chronic muscle tension. Things that aren't fixed with a generic massage or a machine without judgement. Here we work with expert manual technique and specific protocols for each case.

pain.p_html: You're not arriving from nowhere. You're coming after trying other things that didn't quite work.

items.h3_html: Your legs feel heavy and your circulation sluggish.
items.p_html: Despite the exercise and the diet. It's fluid retention and poor microcirculation. The gym doesn't fix it — drainage does.

items.h3_html: You've had surgery and the recovery is dragging.
items.p_html: Aesthetic surgery, abdominal surgery, orthopaedic procedures. Without specific post-operative drainage, inflammation builds up and slows your return to normal life.

items.h3_html: You live with chronic muscle tension.
items.p_html: Hours at a desk or intense training. Lower back, neck, legs. A generic massage relieves you for a day — a serious protocol genuinely releases you.

why.eyebrow: Why body treatments at AnyLopez work
why.h2_html: Six reasons they work here where other places don't.
why.p_html: It's not marketing. It's expert manual work, judgement and validated protocols.

items.h3_html: Expert manual technique from someone with decades of experience
items.p_html: Machines help; hands diagnose while they treat. Here we don't hire trainees to cut costs — you're treated by someone who knows.

items.h3_html: Combinable with INDIBA Radiofrequency if there's associated laxity
items.p_html: We don't only sell our own. If your case needs deep radiofrequency on top of manual work, we say so and combine protocols.
It's not a soft massage with a fancy name. It's the Vodder/Leduc protocol adapted to your case, with specific pressures and rhythm.
After aesthetic surgery or any other procedure, we don't improvise. We know when to start, what intensity, what frequency and why.

items.h3_html: Sessions you feel from the very first one
items.p_html: You don't have to wait 10 sessions to notice something. Drainage, wood therapy and muscle recovery give immediate sensation.

items.h3_html: No needles, no downtime, compatible with your routine
items.p_html: You leave and carry on with your life. No sick leave, no visible marks.

xsell.h2_html: If your case combines body and deep laxity…
xsell.p: Many body protocols are enhanced when combined with INDIBA radiofrequency. If your goal includes skin firming on top of drainage or toning, we combine them in the free diagnosis.

process.h2: Four steps. No surprises, no small print.
process.p: From your first message to seeing the first improvement, less than two weeks pass.

steps.p_html: Call/WhatsApp to find a slot. 30 min at the clinic, no cost, no commitment.

We assess you: area, history, goal. If you come post-surgery, we look at the medical report. If it's fluid retention, we palpate to identify the type. If it's muscle tension, we evaluate the postural chain.

steps.h3: Tailored protocol with sessions and frequency
steps.p_html: Not "come 10 times". We design how many sessions you actually need and at what cadence. And if yours is solved in 4, we tell you so.
Direct WhatsApp for questions, adjustments and post-treatment guidance.
